Cheap near your mood, dear far from it; casting pulls your mood towards the spell
Makes: conjures what you remember; raises Coherence, heals, repairs
Your mood; each use wears the bead's Hold

A memory is a bead: it gives the shape, and what you feed decides how the conjuration feels and behaves. Vividness sets detail and duration; faint memories give illusions. Resonance: feeding its own feeling is cheaper and truer, feeding against it twists the result and wears faster; healing and repair need a match. Burning: destroys the bead, releasing its material straight into your mood at the cost of the mood capacity it gave, leaving you Ablaze; heavy Attention. Memories can't be forged
Unmakes: dissolves form, freeing feeling as ambient emotion; lowers Coherence, makes things forget, undoes conjurations and weakly held things
Draws no Attention directly, though the feeling it frees can cancel into lucidity and flare it. Calls on Forgetting, the dark that erodes what is unlit. Provisional
